app._doc: The app harness (capture/app/capture.mjs). baseUrl null runs the example app in capture/app/example-app/ on a local port. Point it at your product instead: baseUrl = your dev server (http://localhost:3000, or a hostname listed in hostMap), apiPrefixes = where the browser sends API calls (a path on the app origin, or another origin such as http://127.0.0.1:8787/), and answer each call in capture/app/fixtures.mjs.

cli._doc: The CLI harness (capture/cli/capture.mjs). Each run executes `run` in capture/cli/work/ with baseUrlEnv pointing at the fixture API and keyEnv set to fakeKey, saves the output, and types `typed` on screen. {cli} is capture/cli, {film} the film folder. Replace the example CLI (tidewell.mjs) with your product's real CLI command.
